# McCaigs Full AI Context

> McCaigs is a Scottish technical studio in Edinburgh building practical AI systems, deterministic assistants, automation, websites, internal tools, and digital products for SMEs, startups, and specialist organisations.

McCaigs focuses on useful, production-ready systems rather than AI theatre. The studio builds deterministic and structured software where reliability matters, and uses AI only where it adds clear value. Its work spans AI Visibility, Answer Engine Optimisation, deterministic assistants, business automation, internal platforms, modern website systems, and focused digital products.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://www.mccaigs.com/): Overview of McCaigs, Scotland's Elite Technical Studio.
- [About McCaigs](https://www.mccaigs.com/about): Background on the studio, positioning, and approach.
- [Technical Studio](https://www.mccaigs.com/studio): How McCaigs works as a technical studio for Scottish SMEs, startups, and organisations.
- [Services](https://www.mccaigs.com/services): Practical AI systems, automation, internal platforms, websites, and product development services.
- [Systems](https://www.mccaigs.com/systems): Examples of the kinds of systems McCaigs designs and builds.
- [Process](https://www.mccaigs.com/process): The studio process for diagnosing, designing, building, evaluating, and shipping work.
- [Start a Project](https://www.mccaigs.com/start-project): Project enquiry and deterministic project-shaping route.
- [Contact](https://www.mccaigs.com/contact): Contact page for project enquiries.

## AI Visibility and AEO

- [AI Visibility](https://www.mccaigs.com/ai-visibility): McCaigs' approach to helping businesses become easier for AI search systems and answer engines to understand.
- [Answer Engine Optimisation](https://www.mccaigs.com/answer-engine-optimisation): Service page for structuring websites so answer engines can understand the business, services, and useful source material.
- [AI Search Optimisation](https://www.mccaigs.com/ai-search-optimisation): Practical search visibility work for AI-assisted discovery.
- [ChatGPT SEO](https://www.mccaigs.com/chatgpt-seo): Preparation work for clearer business signals in AI-assisted recommendations.
- [Google AI Overviews Readiness](https://www.mccaigs.com/google-ai-overviews): Technical and content readiness for AI-assisted search surfaces.
- [AI-ready Websites](https://www.mccaigs.com/ai-ready-websites): Website systems designed to be fast, structured, crawlable, and clear to humans and machines.
- [AI Visibility Case Study](https://www.mccaigs.com/ai-visibility-case-study): Example of how structured content, deterministic answers, and technical SEO can support AI discovery.
- [Assistant](https://www.mccaigs.com/assistant): Deterministic assistant demonstrating approved-answer retrieval without relying on an LLM in the critical path.
